title: Improve signature pad visibility and add falcon ID favicon; fix build/deployment issues

requirements.text: Improve the signature pad so users can clearly see the signature while drawing even when the site is in dark mode (dark background). Update the signature canvas styling and drawing configuration to ensure strong contrast between the canvas background and the ink color in both light and dark themes.

quotes: Make sure people can see what there drawing for there signature the background is dark so its hard to see the signature being drawn

acceptanceCriteria: In dark mode, the signature strokes are clearly visible while drawing (high contrast) without requiring users to change their OS/browser theme.
In light mode, the signature strokes remain clearly visible and the signature pad remains visually consistent with the rest of the UI.
The signature pad still supports mouse + touch drawing, clearing, and emits a PNG data URL via onSignatureChange when drawing ends.

requirements.text: Fix signature pad canvas rendering issues related to sizing and clearing so that the drawn signature is not distorted/blurry and the clear action fully resets the drawing surface. Ensure canvas sizing accounts for devicePixelRatio correctly and that clearing resets the canvas to the intended background.

quotes: Make sure people can see what there drawing for there signature the background is dark so its hard to see the signature being drawn

acceptanceCriteria: Signature strokes are crisp (not scaled/blurry) on standard and high-DPI screens.
Clicking “Clear” fully clears the signature content and restores the pad background so new strokes are immediately visible.
If the canvas is re-measured (e.g., initial render/layout changes), drawing coordinates still align with the pointer location.

requirements.text: Generate a site favicon and apple touch icon featuring a falcon with the letters “ID”, matching the existing site theme, and ensure the app uses these icons via the existing <link rel="icon"> and <link rel="apple-touch-icon"> tags in frontend/index.html.

quotes: also generate a favicon and use it (A falcon with ID to fit website theme)

acceptanceCriteria: The generated favicon file exists at frontend/public/assets/generated/falcon-ids-favicon-gothic.dim_32x32.webp.
The generated apple touch icon file exists at frontend/public/assets/generated/falcon-ids-apple-touch-gothic.dim_180x180.webp.
After building and deploying, browsers load the favicon and apple touch icon successfully (no 404s), and the icons visually depict a falcon with the letters “ID”.

requirements.text: Audit the project for other errors/issues that could cause build or deployment failures (including missing assets referenced by the frontend and runtime errors), and fix the issues found so the app builds cleanly.

quotes: figure out any other errors issues fix them

acceptanceCriteria: A production frontend build completes without errors.
No missing static assets are referenced at runtime (no 404s for files referenced in HTML/CSS/TSX for critical UI paths).
Key user flows (sign-in, dashboard navigation, creating an order including signature capture) function without console errors in production mode.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing shadcn components instead).
Do not edit immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only introduce backend state migrations if strictly required.
nonGoals: Do not introduce new authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
Do not add new third-party services or external databases.
Do not redesign unrelated pages or add new product features beyond signature visibility, favicon assets, and fixing concrete build/runtime issues.

required: Favicon icon illustration of a falcon with the letters “ID”, gothic/high-tech styling, transparent or clean solid background (falcon-ids-favicon-gothic.dim_32x32.webp)
Apple touch icon illustration of a falcon with the letters “ID”, gothic/high-tech styling, centered composition (falcon-ids-apple-touch-gothic.dim_180x180.webp)
